response.sql: WITH combos AS (SELECT o.recordvault AS order_ref, o.orderflow AS status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.recordvault, o.orderflow), shares AS (SELECT order_ref, status, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY status) AS share FROM combos), gaps AS (SELECT order_ref, status, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY status) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT order_ref, status, cnt AS record_count, share, share - avg_share AS share_above_avg FROM gaps ORDER BY share_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10
